item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-10-08

item.title: Pre-RFC Discussion: Activating the Nervos DAO Treasury (1 posts)
item.description: Thanks @chenyukang for sharing the Optimistic Tally!! An overview: A proposal is a Type ID cell holding a bond. Vote cells reference the voter’s DAO deposits, which must be older than the proposal. Weight is the deposits’ capacity. Counting cells certify YES votes in slices of voters, split by lock hash prefix. After the voting period, the proposer finalizes the proposal with at least yes_threshold YES votes. During the challenge period anyone can challenge with certified NO votes. If NO votes are at least YES votes, the proposal is rejected and the challenger takes the bond. Otherwise it passes. An administrator config cell sets all parameters, can halt the system and can veto finalized...
